mainEntity.name: What types of finish carpentry does Frasheski Construction coordinate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction coordinates a wide range of finish carpentry elements, including interior and exterior trim, crown molding, baseboards, door and window casings, custom cabinetry, built-in shelving, wainscoting, and specialty millwork. We manage the installation of both pre-fabricated and custom-made pieces. Our expertise covers diverse architectural styles common in areas like Albany and El Cerrito, ensuring each detail complements the overall design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction coordinates installation for various finish carpentry elements such as trim, moldings, custom cabinetry, and built-ins, suiting diverse architectural styles.
